title: After less than 4 months, the clock is barely ...
text: After less than 4 months, the clock is barely .... After less than 4 months, the clock is barely functioning. Some other reviewers have mentioned this - the purple light on ours has completely stopped working. In the last few days, the face of the clock has been slowly disappearing when the yellow light is on, and is now completely invisible. The only way it works is with no light on, which completely defeats the purpose of the entire thing. I paid $10 for the adaptor too so I'm really unhappy that it's $50 down the drain. If you're unsure, just go with a different clock altogether.

product_metadata.title: My Sleep Clock (Power Adapter Sold Separately)
features: My Tot Clock has a new little brother...My Sleep Clock! It includes several of the best features at a lower cost!
Lullabies, Wake Music, and White Noise stored on My Sleep Clock (no separate Tot Clock Treasure is required).
Runs on AC Power or 4 AA Batteries (power adapter and batteries sold separately). Energy-Saver feature extends battery life up to 1 month.
Includes a Weekend WakeTime Feature (different wake times for weekdays and weekends)

Changeable Faceplates make My Sleep Clock even more fun for tiny tots! Match My Tot Clock to your child's interests or bedroom theme! Ships with the Moon & Stars faceplate. Other fun faceplate designs sold separately, including Princess, Dora the Explorer, Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles, and Dinosaur Train!
description: My Sleep Clock changes colors to teach little ones when to sleep (blue light) and when it's okay to wake (yellow light). It also has a separate nap time function (purple light). Parents set the routine using controls hidden behind the removable Faceplate! Comes with the Night Sky Faceplate. My Sleep Clock, with analog and digital clock displays, also plays lullabies, fun wake-up music, and even white noise to make the traditionally stressful bedtime and morning routines more enjoyable. Runs on AC power or batteries. Power adapter and batteries sold separately. Measures 7" x 5.5" x 2". Guaranteed better sleep or your money back!
